name: Last USD
oneLiner: USDXL is Last's synthetic dollar minted as CDP-style debt against blue-chip collateral on HypurrFi (Aave-V3 fork on HyperEVM), with no public redemption rail.
collateral: Position-backed synthetic dollar minted against blue-chip overcollateralized positions on HypurrFi's Aave V3 fork on HyperEVM, with protocol-owned liquidity and stablecoin reserves including USDT0 supporting secondary liquidity. Eligible borrow collateral includes HYPE and HYPE LSTs, bridged BTC, and ETH.
pegMechanism: Users open overcollateralized CDP-style borrows on HypurrFi and mint USDXL against their position; repayment burns the synthetic dollar. Liquidations and protocol-owned liquidity defend the peg, but public docs do not describe an enabled direct 1:1 holder redemption against issuer reserves.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: HypurrFi's official USDXL reference describes USDXL as a CDP-hybrid synthetic dollar. Hyperliquid's official tokenDetails endpoint records the tracked HyperCore USDXL token deployTime as 2025-03-22, establishing the current deployment boundary.

notices.title: HypurrFi market closure deadline
notices.message: HypurrFi announced that Legacy and Pooled markets will wind down and close by July 15, 2026. USDXL borrow rates were raised to 30% to incentivize repayment before closure; users with debt positions should verify repayment and migration routes directly in HypurrFi/Euler tooling.

notices.title: No direct public redemption rail
notices.message: USDXL is minted and repaid through HypurrFi debt positions. Pharos does not model a redemption backstop because public Last/HypurrFi materials reviewed do not expose an enabled direct 1:1 holder redemption route.

notices.title: Implementation date not publicly established
notices.message: Safety Score V9 implementation-date review on 2026-07-14 checked the current Last, HypurrFi, and USDXL deployment materials but found no reliable dated launch or implementation event for the scored USDXL implementation; no date is inferred.
